neighbours.label: website navigation elements (navigation bar, menu links, back button, signposting)
fire: The main navigation menu appears at the top of every page on the site.
Click the back button in the toolbar to return to the previous screen.
Breadcrumb links help visitors see where they are within the website.
The sidebar contains navigation links to all sections of the documentation.
On mobile, the navigation collapses into a hamburger icon.
Clear wayfinding signage helps visitors find their way around the park.
Add a link in the footer that points back to the home page.
Users got lost because the site's menu structure was confusing.
quiet: The main article appears in Monday's print edition of the paper.
Click the save button after you finish typing your message.
Photographs help visitors see what the hotel rooms look like.
The sidebar contains a short biography of the author.
On mobile, the photos load more slowly than on desktop.
Fresh paint and new benches made the park more pleasant.
Add a note in the footer with the copyright year.
Users were happy because the site's colors were pleasant.
